central_claims.claim: Trajectory-dependent gates reduce waste better than uniform policies.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: The reported A100 experiments and profiled stages support this claim under the two evaluated backends.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: Pose/FoV similarity must exist and temporal adaptation is not fully instantiated on both backends.

central_claims.claim: The full pipeline realizes 2.59× on HY-WorldPlay and 1.61× on Matrix-Game-3.0.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: The reported A100 experiments and profiled stages support this claim under the two evaluated backends.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: Backend-dependent wall-clock result on one A100; not a universal speedup.

central_claims.claim: Triton fusion converts sparse computation into wall-clock benefit.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: The reported A100 experiments and profiled stages support this claim under the two evaluated backends.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: 1.40× applies to sparse-attention portion, not end-to-end.

negative_or_limiting_results: SVG is 0.92×/0.62× and BSA is 0.48×/0.94×, showing algorithmic sparsity can be slower.
Only sparse attention lowers HY-WorldPlay fidelity to PSNR 25.53 versus context-only variants.
Matrix TeaCache has stronger retrospective metrics but lower VBench.

mechanism_result_map.result: KV reconstruction, latency, and memory reduction
about 4 to 3 effective denoising steps on average

comparative_positioning: Uniform cache/sparse baselines lack interaction-state gating.
AR Q/K asymmetry and causal layout distinguish this from bidirectional video DiT acceleration.
reuse_takeaways: Use a semantic/geometric control signal to gate several inference shortcuts jointly.
Report theoretical sparsity and measured stage latency separately.
followup_questions: Can a learned reliability estimator replace explicit pose/FoV signals without retraining the generator?
How do gains scale on H100/B200 and alternative attention backends?
